title: Clean Simple Eats Vanilla Whey Protein

comparisons.notes: Simply Vanilla 30 Serving Bag, SKU 1630VAN1, barcode 810093784837; store product data shows available.

writeup: Clean Simple Eats Simply Vanilla whey isolate comes in a 30-serving bag with 20g of grass-fed whey per scoop. Woot has it new for $38.91, while Clean Simple Eats' own store charges $64.99 for the same bag, about 40% more. Stock is very limited at 3 units with a limit of 3 per customer, and non-Prime buyers pay $6 shipping.
amazon_match_notes: Same UPC 810093784837 as official store listing, verified by price checker.
